tagline: Discover government schemes that may be relevant to your family
disclaimer: Information is for guidance only. Please confirm eligibility on the official website.

hero.title: Find government schemes that may be relevant to your family
hero.subtitle: A privacy-first platform that connects Indian households to social protection, scholarships, pensions, and welfare opportunities with plain-language explanations.
hero.ruleNote: No Aadhaar or bank details requested. We provide algorithmic guidance, not guaranteed eligibility.

howItWorks.title: How SchemeSaathi Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Provide basic non-sensitive details such as age, state, and occupation. No ID numbers required.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our eligibility engine checks rules and explains exactly why each scheme may be relevant to you.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Read required documents and click directly to official government portals to submit your application.
